rawContent: @MrDane1982 Mr. Weeks, I’m a fan. And agree the assaulted boys deserve more coverage. But I don’t get blaming #MeToo. I see a LOT of women fighting on the right side of this issue - just not linking the hashtag, which is associated not only with sexual assault but with entrenched misogyny.

@MrDane1982 @AnnKen17 Anthony, I’m a fan, but when you are in a hole, stop digging. You won’t persuade women by trashing their motives around #MeToo. You’re being a distraction, not a help. You’ve made this about owning a hashtag, not about the boy victims. The point is, it happens to #BoysToo right?
